name: 西游记451
group_note: 西游记451 (ES II mudlib family, v4.50). Registration has no 'new' keyword: any English id without an existing save falls straight through to 'use X as a new character, confirm? (y/n)'. Gift-stat allocation is a reroll loop ('accept this set? [n|y|q]', n rerolls, y accepts, q presumably aborts) rather than the field-select menu seen in the SanJie/xyj2000 family. WASM pass caught proactively via scripts/lib_bulk_fix.py + scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (both new this session) before the first boot test: (1) the standard §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (str[0] > 160 && str[0] < 255) rewritten to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff, paired with check_legal_name()'s i%2 parity gate/[i..<0] suffix slice fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i]; (2) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() forwarded straight to SECURITY_D with no 'user == this_object()' guard -- the same latent risk that silently killed every registration on xyj20032, fixed proactively though not observed to fire here; (3) 14 is_killing(me)/is_killing(who) call sites across kungfu-skill daemon/class/*.lpc and cmds/std/surrender.lpc passed an object where feature/attack.lpc-equivalent declares is_killing(string id) (§7.50). httpd.lpc/dns_master.lpc are already commented out of adm/etc/preload (dormant, pre-existing) -- left as-is, no compile-crash risk. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Registration verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB select -> English id -> y (confirm new character) -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> y (accept rerolled stats) -> q (skip paginated MOTD) -> enters world at 南城客栈, look/score both clean. Admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 9322 .lpc files (9297 written, 9 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted, 16 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the one case-label-with-trailing-comment hit (ftpd.lpc) diff-reviewed clean. Post-formatter re-verified clean, admin permission still (admin).
